lead_independence.headline: Flooding closes Port St. Lucie roads, suspends St. Lucie County's regular ART service
lead_independence.lead: Flooding forced road closures in Port St. Lucie and temporarily suspended St. Lucie County's regular Area Regional Transit (ART) service Monday as officials urged residents to avoid unnecessary travel. The county activated its Emergency Operations Center and issued a local state of emergency as crews responded to widespread flooding and unsafe driving conditions.

source_focus.source_title: Indian River, St. Lucie counties declare local states of emergency amid widespread flooding
source_focus.source_lead: Lucie counties declared local states of emergency Monday as heavy rainfall and flooding continued to inundate roads and neighborhoods across the Treasure Coast.In Indian River County, County Administrator John A. issued the emergency order in response to ongoing flooding, deteriorating weather conditions and continued rainfall. The county said numerous roads have become impassable, creating public safety concerns.
